build: ( : -p mason-daemon; cargo test --no-fail-fast --target-dir $HOME/.cache/mason-target/$(basename "$PWD") -p mason-daemon --no-run ) && ( : -p mason-onboard --lib; cargo test --no-fail-fast --target-dir $HOME/.cache/mason-target/$(basename "$PWD") -p mason-onboard --lib --no-run ) && ( : -p mason-pipeline --bins --test init --test remote_dispatch --test version_flag; cargo test --no-fail-fast --target-dir $HOME/.cache/mason-target/$(basename "$PWD") -p mason-pipeline --bins --test init --test remote_dispatch --test version_flag --no-run )
command: mason_rc=0; ( : -p mason-daemon; RUSTDOC="$PWD/scripts/rustdoc-bootstrap.sh" cargo test --no-fail-fast --target-dir $HOME/.cache/mason-target/$(basename "$PWD") -p mason-daemon --config 'target."cfg(unix)".runner=["env","RUSTC_BOOTSTRAP=1"]' -- -Z unstable-options --report-time ) || mason_rc=1; ( : -p mason-onboard --lib; RUSTDOC="$PWD/scripts/rustdoc-bootstrap.sh" cargo test --no-fail-fast --target-dir $HOME/.cache/mason-target/$(basename "$PWD") -p mason-onboard --lib --config 'target."cfg(unix)".runner=["env","RUSTC_BOOTSTRAP=1"]' -- -Z unstable-options --report-time ) || mason_rc=1; ( : -p mason-pipeline --bins --test init --test remote_dispatch --test version_flag; RUSTDOC="$PWD/scripts/rustdoc-bootstrap.sh" cargo test --no-fail-fast --target-dir $HOME/.cache/mason-target/$(basename "$PWD") -p mason-pipeline --bins --test init --test remote_dispatch --test version_flag --config 'target."cfg(unix)".runner=["env","RUSTC_BOOTSTRAP=1"]' -- -Z unstable-options --report-time ) || mason_rc=1; [ $mason_rc -eq 0 ]
